description: This file defines the interface for the Service Control APIs related to service restart management in the RDK platform. It includes function declarations for initializing, deinitializing, managing service restart lists, and controlling service restarts, along with necessary imports and licensing information.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter name from a given path.

methods.name: svc_restart_queue_loop
methods.description: Thread loop function for handling service restart queue.

methods.name: spawn_svc_restart_queue_loop
methods.description: Spawns a thread to run the restart queue loop.

methods.name: push_svc_to_queue
methods.description: Pushes a service restart command onto the queue.

methods.name: ServiceControl_Get_Sevice_Restart_List
methods.description: Retrieves the list of services scheduled for restart.

methods.name: ServiceControl_Set_Sevice_Restart_List
methods.description: Sets the list of services scheduled for restart.
